title: Paper Cuts: The Microscopic Saw Effect
caption:
Why does a tiny paper cut hurt SO much?
A cartoon office guy grabs a stack of paper, then clutches his finger screaming as the frames zoom into a microscopic saw edge slicing raw nerves.
Paper edges are tiny saws: they slice shallowly but leave fingertip nerve endings exposed, so pain signals keep firing.
What's the worst place you've ever been paper cut?
Save this before your next paperwork shift, and follow for more body science.
